translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Adiera bad Jehova Nyasaye ok chiek ma ok dores joge,
bende ite ok odino ma ok dowinj wach.
To richou ema osepogou gi Nyasachu;
richou ema omiyo osepandonu wangʼe mondo kik owinju.
Nimar lwetu otimo remo,
kendo usemulo richo.
Dhou osewacho miriambo
kendo leu osehulo gik mamono.
Onge ngʼama dwaro tim makare;
kata manyo bura miyalo gadiera.
Gigeno mana kuom weche manono kendo giwacho miriambo,
gimako ich mar chandruok kendo ginywolo mana richo.
Gibutno e tong thuonde,
kendo gichweyo mbuyi mar otiengʼ-otiengʼ.
Ngʼato angʼata mochamo tongʼ-gi biro tho
kendo kamoro oto to nyathi fu ema wuokie.
Mbui margi ok nyal twangʼ-go nanga,
bende ok ginyal umore giwegi gi gik ma giloso.
Timbegi gin timbe richo;
kendo timbe mag mahundu ni e lwetgi.
Tiendegi reto kadhi timo richo;
giyot ahinya mondo gichwer remo maonge ketho.
Paro manie chunygi gin paro maricho
kendo kamoro amora ma gidhiyoe;
masira gi chandruok ema dongʼie.
Ok gingʼeyo yo makelo kwe,
onge tim makare e yoregi.
Giseloko yorego obedo yore mogondore ogondore,
kendo ngʼato angʼata mawuotho e yorego ok noyud kwe.
Omiyo ngʼado bura makare koro bor kodwa,
kendo tim makare ok chop irwa.
Wagombo ler, to mudho ema waneno;
kendo wadwaro mondo piny oru,
to mudho mandiwa ema wawuothoe.
Wamulo kor udi mana ka muofni,
kendo wamulo kuonde ma wawuothe,
mana ka joma onge wengegi.
Wachwanyore godiechiengʼ,
mana ka gima en otieno
kendo wachalo joma otho e kind joma rateke.
Walak mana ka ondiegi
kendo wadengo malit mana ka akuru.
Wadwaro ngʼado bura makare to ok wayud kata achiel,
kendo wamanyo ngʼama reswa to obor kodwa.
Nimar timbewa mamono opongʼo wangʼi
kendo richowa elore e lela.
Timbewa marichogo osiko kodwa
kendo wayie timbewa mamonogo, ma gin:
ngʼanyo kendo ketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
loko ngʼewa ne Nyasachwa,
chano timo tulo kendo paro weche mag miriambo
ka chunywa opongʼ kod wuond.
Omiyo ngʼado bura makare ogol oko
kendo tim makare ni mabor kodwa,
adiera onge e yore matindo kendo tim makare ni kuma bor.
Adiera ok nyal yudi,
kendo ngʼat motangʼ ne richo chuny ji ojokgo.
Jehova Nyasaye norangogi kendo nokecho
nikech ngʼado bura makare onge kuomgi.
Ne oneno kaonge ngʼato kata achiel,
kendo nobwok ni onge kata ngʼato madikony;
omiyo bade owuon nokelone en owuon warruok
kendo timne makare ema norite.
Norwakore tim makare ka law akor mar nyinyo,
kendo ne orwako warruok ka ogut lweny;
bende ne orwako chulo kuor ka ngʼama rwako law,
kendo nobolo mirima mager kuome ka law abola.
Obiro chulo ngʼato ka ngʼato mana moromore gi timbene,
obiro kumo wasike duto gi mirima mager
kendo obiro kumo joma odakie dho nembe.
Koa yo podho chiengʼ, ji noluor nying Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo koa yo wuok chiengʼ, oganda nomiye duongʼ.
Nimar nobi ka pi mongingore ma much Jehova Nyasaye osekudho.
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya,
“Jalno makelo Resruok nobi Sayun,
mondo ores nyikwa Jakobo moseweyo richogi.”

content: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Akwongʼora ni ma e singruokna kodgi. Roho mara man kuomu kod wechena ma aseketo e dhou nosik kodu chakre kawuono nyaka tiengʼ mabiro bangʼu koa kuom nyikwau kadhi nyaka kuom nyithindgi, wach ok nowuogi e dhog-gi ndalo duto nyaka chiengʼ,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
